package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// OutboxRepoPG leases and updates durable student events.
type OutboxRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (repo OutboxRepoPG) Claim(ctx context.Context, claim repository.OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error) {
	if repo.Pool == nil || strings.TrimSpace(claim.WorkerID) == "" || claim.Limit <= 0 ||
		claim.Now.IsZero() || !claim.LockedUntil.After(claim.Now) {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid outbox claim")
	}
	rows, err := repo.Pool.Query(ctx, `
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM student_outbox
    WHERE published_at IS NULL
      AND next_attempt_at <= $1
      AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= $1)
    ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT $2
)
UPDATE student_outbox AS event
SET locked_by = $3,
    locked_until = $4,
    attempts = event.attempts + 1
FROM candidates
WHERE event.event_id = candidates.event_id
RETURNING event.event_id,
          event.subject,
          event.correlation_id,
          COALESCE(event.causation_id, ''),
          event.student_id,
          event.occurred_at,
          event.schema_version,
          event.payload,
          event.attempts
`, claim.Now.UTC(), claim.Limit, claim.WorkerID, claim.LockedUntil.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	events := make([]domain.IntegrationEvent, 0, claim.Limit)
	for rows.Next() {
		var event domain.IntegrationEvent
		var payload []byte
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&event.EventID,
			&event.Subject,
			&event.CorrelationID,
			&event.CausationID,
			&event.StudentID,
			&event.OccurredAt,
			&event.SchemaVersion,
			&payload,
			&event.Attempts,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !json.Valid(payload) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("outbox event %s contains invalid JSON", event.EventID)
		}
		event.Payload = json.RawMessage(payload)
		events = append(events, event)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return events, nil
}

func (repo OutboxRepoPG) MarkPublished(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID string, publishedAt time.Time) error {
	command, err := repo.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE student_outbox
SET published_at = $3,
    locked_by = NULL,
    locked_until = NULL,
    last_error = NULL
WHERE event_id = $1 AND locked_by = $2 AND published_at IS NULL
`, eventID, workerID, publishedAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("outbox publication lease was lost")
	}
	return nil
}

func (repo OutboxRepoPG) MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID, message string, retryAt time.Time) error {
	command, err := repo.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE student_outbox
SET next_attempt_at = $3,
    locked_by = NULL,
    locked_until = NULL,
    last_error = $4
WHERE event_id = $1 AND locked_by = $2 AND published_at IS NULL
`, eventID, workerID, retryAt.UTC(), message)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("outbox failure lease was lost")
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.Outbox = (*OutboxRepoPG)(nil)
